text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Oh? This presence... Chris, don't get any closer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや？　
この気配……
クリス、
前に出すぎないように。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I've got a bad feeling about this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
どうも嫌な予兆を感じるな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it's building up strength.
It seems to be preparing to shoot a skill that takes a lot of resources.
text_block_list.orig_text:
力を溜めこんでるみたいだ。
それなりにリソースを食う技を撃つつもりらしいね。

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text:
Let's stop it from charging.
There's no reason to wait on your enemy's special attack.
text_block_list.orig_text:
力の蓄積を阻害しましょう。
相手の大技を待って差し上げる必要はありません。

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Do you think the only way to win is to stop the enemy from doing anything significant?
text_block_list.orig_text: 大技ごと断ち切ってこその戦いだと思うがな？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: You're more than welcome to be a wall for us, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text: 壁になってくれるのなら大歓迎だよ？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text: Heh, I have no desire to act as a flesh wall. The pleasure of victory is mine and mine alone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、
オマエたちの肉壁など御免被る。
ワタシの愉しみはワタシだけのものだよ──ッ！
